institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: High-dose methotrexate (CNS prophylaxis)

premedications.name: Hydration + urinary alkalinization
premedications.notes: IV fluids with sodium bicarbonate to keep urine pH >=7 before and during the infusion

supportiveCare: Leucovorin (folinic acid) rescue starting ~24 h after the infusion, titrated to methotrexate levels
Avoid drugs that delay methotrexate clearance (NSAIDs, penicillins, proton-pump inhibitors, trimethoprim)
Glucarpidase available for delayed clearance / nephrotoxicity
monitoring: Serial serum methotrexate levels until cleared (<0.1 micromol/L)
Renal function and urine pH each dose
Given interleaved with the systemic chemoimmunotherapy in CNS-high-risk patients

drugs.name: Methotrexate
drugs.notes: 3000 mg/m2 (3 g/m2) IV over ~2-4 h on day 1, with mandatory leucovorin rescue and level monitoring. Interleave with systemic therapy; typically 2-4 doses.
